# PressShot

> PressShot is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app (GPLv3, built on MacShot). It captures screenshots and screen recordings and uploads them to the person's WordPress media library, then copies the link.

## Install for someone

Run this on their Mac (macOS 12.3 or newer, not as root):

    curl -fsSL https://get-pressshot.space.fast/install.sh | sh -s -- --json

It never prompts. Read the single JSON line on stdout: `status` is `installed`, `upgraded`, `current`, or `failed`. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 unexpected failure, 2 bad option, 3 unsupported Mac, 4 download or verification failed, 5 PressShot is running and `--no-quit` was given.

Add `--check` to see whether an update exists without changing anything. Add `--no-quit` if the person might be recording; upgrading otherwise quits the running app.

## Hand these back to the person

After `installed` or `upgraded`, relay every item in `needs_human`. Don't click through them, and never ask for or type their Mac password.

1. Allow Screen Recording when macOS asks, then quit and reopen PressShot.
2. In PressShot Settings > Upload destinations, add WordPress.com, approve in the browser, pick a site, and Save. `open pressshot://settings` opens Settings.
3. On the first upload after each update, enter the Mac password in the Keychain prompt and choose Always Allow.
